messages.content: I need to retrieve server responses for certain user queries. Can you send a GET request to 'https://example.com/api/intent' for the following intents: ['get_balance', 'transfer_funds', 'hello', 'goodbye']? Here are the user queries that need to be matched with the intents: ['hello', 'I want to transfer funds'].

function.name: get_response
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves the server's response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent.

intents.description: A list of intent codes based on user queries, such as 'get_balance' and 'transfer_funds'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds to wait for the server response. The default is 2.5 seconds. This is a float type value.

Accept.description: The MIME types that are acceptable for the response, such as 'application/json'.

User-Agent.description: The user agent string of the software that is initiating the request, such as 'Mozilla/5.0'.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the GET request. If not provided, default headers will be used.
